chapter: Later views and life in Dallas
title: Fishing at night with pipelines
summary: Smith loves fishing, learned it from his father, and fishes at night 40 or 50 miles away with pipeline lines.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues

blocks.x: You're a very keen fisherman, aren't you.
Yeah. Yeah, I love to fish.
Where do you fish?
Anywhere. In all the lakes! Heh-heh.
You go to lakes or rivers?
Yeah, I go to lakes.
What kind of fish do you fish for?
I fish for all of them. Brim, cats, and the crawfish. I fish for all the fish except the carp fish. I don't care nothin' about him.
Do you eat the fish or do you just fish for fun?
I fish for fun. Relaxing. I eat them. But it's (?) about eating it, though.
Why do you like to do it?

Well, I went to the creek with my Daddy. He just lived on the creek all the time. He kept lines in the water. He worked in the field, but he kept them in the water, and he'd catch a great big fish tall as he was. And he fished in the river, the Trent(?) River, all the time. And I guess I got it from him. My mother says it's the birthmark(?). I just love it. I used to go every other day. I used to go every day when didn't have nothin' to do, until the gas got too high...
Buster Smith - 226
How far out of town do you go to do it?
Oh, about 40 or 50 miles.
40 or 50 miles!?
Yes.
So you stay for the night?
I mostly fish at night.
You stay up all night.
Yeah.
And then come back and sleep during the day.
Yeah. Sometimes I set my stuff out and lay down about midnight, and sleep until daylight. I mostly fish at night.
So this isn't rod and line fishing. This is just you put lines out.

Yeah. Well, I put out lines sometimes. Most of the time I have what you call a pipeline. Stick it in the ground and put about two or three hooks on it, and then put a big weight on it and throw it out in the water and bait it, and then let it lay out there. I put out about 10 or 11 of them up and down the creek, and let them stay there. Sometimes I catch a whole tub full of fish. They'll be catfish. But when you want to fish for scale fish you have to get your pole and...
You can do that, too?
Yes.
Buster Smith - 227
Are you allowed to go and fish in any creek like this?
Allowed to go there?
Yeah. I mean, is it not privately owned?
Oh, no. I don't go to them kind of places. No, you get in bad going there. I always go where it's something that the state got something to do with, for anybody to fish.
What do you use as bait?

I use worms, minnows... Mostly worms and minnows. Shrimp. That's mostly it. You catch good fish with minnows. And you catch your cats with worms, something like that... You usually get too many carp with (?) and I don't have too much use... Ain't much to him.
